errors.text: The specific AuCoCuNiPt system is replaced by generic or CoCrFeMnNi-like alloys, eliminating the Au/Cu surface-energy contrast central to the target mechanism.
The predicted transformation is bulk-like phase separation, ordering, or amorphization rather than selective Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation.
The proposed argon aging at 800 °C for up to 100 hours does not reconstruct the vacuum in situ ramp to 973 K or its discrete observation conditions.
The cited evidence concerns mainly bulk or irradiated HEAs and does not directly support the asserted nanoparticle size threshold, entropy reduction at surfaces, or rapid nanoparticle decomposition.
